requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall have all markings clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking of the rear combination lamp, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear combination lamp shall consist of the following elements:
requirements.quote: The approval marking shall consist of:

requirements.text: The sequential number of the approval number of the rear combination lamp shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the rear combination lamp shall bear the additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.quote: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant

requirements.text: Except where the rear combination lamp has non-replaceable light sources, the rear combination lamp shall bear a marking indicating: (a) the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed; (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating:

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp has (a) an electronic light source control gear; and/or (b) a variable luminous intensity control; and/or (c) a secondary operating mode; and/or (d) non-replaceable light sources, the rear combination lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with:

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) are used, the specific identification code of the module shall comprise the starting letters "MD" for "MODULE" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.
requirements.quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) are used, the approval mark on the light source module need not be the same as the one on the rear combination lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp's electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control, being part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the rear combination lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.

requirements.text: In any case, the approval marking of the rear combination lamp as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the rear combination lamp is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.text: If an outer lens is used for several devices and bears different approval markings, the main body of each device of the rear combination lamp shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component of the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: (a) shall be affixed on the component.

requirements.text: Where the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps of the rear combination lamp have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed on the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps of the rear combination lamp, the single approval mark may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the conditions of the following paragraphs are met.
requirements.quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that:

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark on the rear combination lamp shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

requirements.text: Each rear combination lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall meet the requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible, the rear combination lamp shall meet the requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which the lamp may be subjected in such use, its satisfactory operation remains assured and it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where front and rear position lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated, the front and rear position lamps may also be used as end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.quote: Front and rear position lamps which are grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated may also be used as end-outline marker lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the rear position lamp and the stop lamp functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either:

requirements.text: In either case, a note shall be made within the communication document for the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: In either case, a note shall be made within the communication document.

requirements.text: When requested by the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) of the rear combination lamp may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components, provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the following conditions are met.
requirements.quote: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the following conditions:

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the logo's brand name shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2.).
requirements.quote: This shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.quote: (b) Size: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: The stop lamp, the direction indicator lamp, and the reversing lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.quote: (d) Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.quote: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, the rear combination lamp shall apply at least one of the following provisions:
requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply:

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, the light intensity of the rear combination lamp shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or
requirements.quote: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s)

requirements.text: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the rear combination lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles; this shall be noted in the communication form.
requirements.quote: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles; this shall be noted in the communication form

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the rear combination lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: (a) The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder of the rear combination lamp shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
requirements.quote: (b) The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.1 1Compliance with the requirements for electromagnetic compatibility is relevant to the vehicle type.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) of the rear combination lamp shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s); and (b) it is tamperproof; and (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that

requirements.text: When the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the rear combination lamp shall meet the photometric requirements of the device.
requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall be measured, photometrically and colorimetrically, with respect to the following conditions.
requirements.quote: General provisions All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the rear combination lamp, with respect to the conditions for photometric and colorimetric measurements (particulars of the methods of measurement to be used are given in Annex 3).
requirements.quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp (function) uses light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp (function) uses light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
requirements.quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp (function) uses light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the applicant may be required by the test laboratory to provide samples of the rear combination lamp allowing the different light source(s) to be supplied separately.
requirements.quote: The test laboratory may require from the applicant samples allowing to supply the different light source(s) separately.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one position or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities of the rear combination lamp shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear combination lamp, as a light-signalling lamp, shall be determined.
requirements.quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.

requirements.text: In the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators of the rear combination lamp, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined.

requirements.text: The requirement to determine the limits of the apparent surface shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps of the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the rear combination lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the rear combination lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant during testing.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the electronic light source control gear or the variable intensity control may be required by the test laboratory to be supplied.
requirements.quote: The test laboratory may require the electronic light source control gear or the variable intensity control

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the rear combination lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), or, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control: 4.8.2.2.1. in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant; 4.8.2.2.2. in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities;

requirements.text: The identification of the electronic light source control gear if applicable or variable intensity control if applicable and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1 for the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: The identification of an electronic light source control gear if applicable or variable intensity control if applicable and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall comply with the provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity.
requirements.quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.

requirements.text: Where the applicant requests an additional test to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the rear combination lamp shall have a maximum intensity of not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction.
requirements.quote: In addition, in order to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the applicant may request an additional test, to show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1cd.

requirements.text: Where the applicant requests the additional test for visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear, the additional test of the rear combination lamp may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.
requirements.quote: This additional test may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities of the rear combination lamp shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall have the colour of the light emitted measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.quote: Colour of light emitted The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics of the rear combination lamp, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall show no sharp variation of colour outside the field of the light distribution grid.
requirements.quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp (functions) uses different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
requirements.quote: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.

requirements.text: The test laboratory may require from the applicant samples of the rear combination lamp allowing to supply the different light source(s) separately.
requirements.quote: The test laboratory may require from the applicant samples allowing to supply the different light source(s) separately.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10¹ cd shall be permitted for the rear position lamp below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.quote: However, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity of the reversing lamp may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10¹ cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be white.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV for the rear combination lamp shall give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.quote: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the rear combination lamp should have a substantially uniform light pattern, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.quote: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern should be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.

requirements.text: If visual examination of the reversing lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp (functions) uses incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp (functions) uses light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the reversing lamp luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp (functions) uses light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV:

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the rear combination lamp shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements for the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred.
requirements.quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: When the direction indicator lamp of the rear combination lamp is operated for testing, the direction indicator lamp shall be operated in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
requirements.quote: Operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).

requirements.text: Where the luminous intensity distribution of the rear combination lamp after 1 min of operation is calculated, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distributions of the rear combination lamp at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity distributions at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which the rear combination lamp may be subjected, the rear combination lamp retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall not be capable of being inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the rear combination lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road and parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the rear combination lamp shall be allowed a tolerance of ±3° in each direction.
requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall be fitted in compliance with any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear combination lamp shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the rear combination lamp shall satisfy the above requirements so far as is possible.
requirements.quote: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.

requirements.text: While the lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another in the rear combination lamp, the rear combination lamp shall fulfil all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When all other functions with which a lamp of the rear combination lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, the lamp shall fulfil the photometric and colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated in the rear combination lamp with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with the rear position lamp, and the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON, each of these other functions shall fulfil the requirements regarding colour.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: Where the single lamp has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or

requirements.text: Where the single lamp has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts and the 60 per cent area requirement is not met, the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.quote: (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: The single lamp of the rear combination lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included in the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens of the rear combination lamp, the lamps and apparent surfaces shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: A lamp of the rear combination lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.quote: However, a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall have its maximum height above the ground measured from the highest point and its minimum height measured from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of the rear combination lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear combination lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of the rear combination lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary:

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear combination lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: White light emitted by the rear combination lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle, except where the white light is emitted by the reversing lamp.
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, the rear combination lamp shall have no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, the rear combination lamp shall have no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the rear combination lamp shall be deemed to fulfil the requirement above if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear combination lamp shall be such that the rear position lamps, the rear end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the rear combination lamp shall have all light sources switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp's reversing lamp function shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: White 8Also known as white or colourless retro-reflector. 9Nothing in this Regulation shall preclude the Contracting Parties applying this Regulation from allowing the use of white conspicuity markings to the rear in their territories.

requirements.text: The number of rear combination lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp is installed on a movable component, the rear combination lamp shall fulfil the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.
requirements.quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

requirements.text: If the complete interdependent lamp system is mounted on the moving component(s), the rear combination lamp shall satisfy the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1.
requirements.quote: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: If the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) of the rear combination lamp specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) of the rear combination lamp specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the rear combination lamp installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the rear combination lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: If the value of 0.15 per cent is exceeded, each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps, rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors of the rear combination lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or 5.21.2.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp is approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., the rear combination lamp shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement of the light source of the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.

requirements.text: During temporary replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: When electric power supply conditions are not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the rear combination lamp shall not exceed, in the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s), 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: Where the means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device is located within the body of the device for convenience, the rear combination lamp may contain that means of controlling the maximum voltage within its body.
requirements.quote: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp includes an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128, the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to the rear combination lamp.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the rear combination lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

requirements.text: If, when the rear combination lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, all lamps (devices) of the rear combination lamp shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp is installed on a vehicle approved according to this Regulation and is approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, the rear combination lamp shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.
requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles, the reversing lamp may be at a maximum height increased to 1,400 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

requirements.text: If installed, the two optional reversing lamp devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp is of category S1 or S2 on an M1 or N1 category vehicle, the stop lamp shall be positioned such that the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: Where the stop lamps are of category S1 or S2 on vehicles other than M1 and N1 category vehicles, the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.

requirements.text: Where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm, the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces of the stop lamps in the direction of the reference axes may be reduced to 400 mm.
requirements.quote: This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp is of category S3 or S4, the centre of reference of the stop lamp shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where two stop lamps of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., the stop lamps shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.

requirements.text: Where one S3 or S4 category stop lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., the offset of the stop lamp shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

requirements.text: If the optional stop lamps of category S1 or S2 are installed, the optional stop lamps shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp is of category S1 or S2, the stop lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 are mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp is of category S3 or S4, the stop lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle;

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp is of category S1 or S2, the stop lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Where a stop lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°;

requirements.text: Where an optional stop lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the upward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp is of category S3 or S4, the stop lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: When the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H, all stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously.
requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned such that the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall meet the requirements applicable to the vehicle category.
requirements.quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall:

requirements.text: For vehicles of categories other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm.

requirements.text: Where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes may be reduced to 400 mm.
requirements.quote: This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional rear position lamps are installed, the optional rear position lamps shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°;

requirements.text: Where an optional rear position lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the upward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. is applied for an M1 or N1 category vehicle with a rear side-marker lamp installed, and where the rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Where the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. is applied for an M1 or N1 category vehicle with a rear side-marker lamp installed, the rear position lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Where the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. is applied for an M1 or N1 category vehicle with a rear side-marker lamp installed, and where the rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded from the apparent surface of the rear position lamp considered for visibility.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that the rear position lamp is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: However, if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamp shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.

requirements.text: The parking lamp function may also be performed by simultaneously switching ON the front and rear position lamps on the same side of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Other requirements The functioning of this lamp may also be performed by simultaneously switching ON the front and rear position lamps on the same side of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be positioned such that the point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall meet the requirements applicable to the vehicle category.
requirements.quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall:

requirements.text: For vehicles of categories other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm.
